title: Knock, knock! 敲敲门！
description: A knock at the door turns out to be no one at all. Helen invites Jim to have lunch in the garden. The lesson covers 'anyone/anybody', 'anything/anything', 'nothing/nobody/nowhere', 'invite', 'impossible' and 'joke'.
answer_note: Workbook A (Expected answers) and B (Vocabulary) are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-112-117.jpg). Grammar I-III are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.551-552). Grammar source audit: see reports/grammar-source-audit.json; source section order, complete prompts and answers restored.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: I'll knock again, Helen. Everything's very quiet. I'm sure there's no one at home.
lines.translation: 海伦，我再敲一次。毫无动静。我肯定家里没有人。

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.text: But that's impossible. Carol and Tom invited us to lunch. Look through the window.
lines.translation: 但那不可能。卡罗尔和汤姆请我们来吃午饭。透过窗户看看。

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden. It's nice and warm out here.
lines.translation: 大家都想在花园里吃午饭。外面暖和又舒适。

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Come and have something to drink.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Thanks, Carol. May I have a glass of beer, please?
lines.translation: 谢谢你，卡罗尔。请给我一杯啤酒好吗？

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Beer? There's none left. You can have some lemonade.
lines.translation: 啤酒？没有了。你可以喝点柠檬水。

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Don't believe her, Jim. She's only joking. Have some beer!
lines.translation: 别听她的，吉姆。她只是在开玩笑。喝点啤酒吧！

items.meaning: 任何人（用于疑问句、否定式）

items.title: 1. Isn't there anyone at home? 家里没有人吗？
items.text: 在英语中，由 some, any, no, every 与 -one, -thing 组成的复合词，起代词作用，常被称为不定代词，这是因为我们常常不清楚其所指的是谁或什么。

items.title: 2. nice and ...
items.text: 用于形容词或副词前面以加强语气，一般表示褒义，但有时也用于贬义。

items.title: 3. There's none left.
items.text: 一点都没剩下。句中的 left 是个过去分词，用来修饰 none。

No, nothing at all.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Fill in the blanks with somewhere, anywhere, everywhere or nowhere
grammar.instruction: Fill in the blanks with somewhere, anywhere, everywhere or nowhere
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=550

questions.prompt:
A: What're you doing now? You're looking for something, aren't you?
B: Yes, I'm looking for my watch. I left it ___ this morning.
questions.answer: somewhere

audio_segments.text: What're you doing now? You're looking for something, aren't you?
Yes, I'm looking for my watch. I left it somewhere this morning.

questions.prompt:
A: Did you look for it in your office?
B: I looked ___ in my office, but I couldn't find it ___.
questions.answer: everywhere; anywhere

audio_segments.text: Did you look for it in your office?
I looked everywhere in my office, but I couldn't find it anywhere.

questions.prompt: A: Can it be ___ in your room?
questions.answer: anywhere

audio_segments.text: Can it be anywhere in your room?

questions.prompt: B: I'm sure it must be ___ in my room, and I've looked ___ in the room for an hour, but still I can't find it ___. It isn't in my office and it isn't in my room. It's ___! I've lost it!
questions.answer: somewhere; everywhere; anywhere; nowhere

audio_segments.text: I'm sure it must be somewhere in my room, and I've looked everywhere in the room for an hour, but still I can't find it anywhere.
It isn't in my office and it isn't in my room. It's nowhere! I've lost it!
